questions.question: Which resume version should we link as the PDF?

options.label: resume-full.md (Recommended)
options.description: The 2-page version. Best default for a public PDF — recruiters skim, this is the right length.

options.label: resume-all.md
options.description: The complete record. More content, more to read; appropriate only when depth is asked for.

options.label: Both, two links
options.description: Public a Full + an All version; let the visitor pick. More clicks but more information.

options.label: Skip PDF for now
options.description: Don't link a resume PDF on v1 of the refreshed site. Add later.

questions.question: How should the AI angle land on the public site?

options.label: Capability line only (Recommended)
options.description: One line in About: 'I lean heavily on LLMs and agentic CLIs in my dev workflow.' Matches resume. NO claims about AI features in DS Trader / FamilyFund.

options.label: Capability + Interests
options.description: The capability line plus a small 'Interests: LLMs, human–AI interfaces, education' note. Slightly more emphasis.

options.label: No AI mention at all
options.description: Strip every AI/LLM reference from the public site. Resume keeps its Interests line; the website stays purely about systems.

The website review surfaces something more urgent than I expected. Let me lay it out.

**🚨 The live site is badly out of sync.** Published 2026-05-22 at `jdtogni78/jdtogni-site` (and Cloudflare-deployed to jdtogni.dev once you point the domain) — but the AI-flagship narrative was scrubbed from the codebase on **2026-05-23**, and the site has never been regenerated. So the recruiter-facing landing page still says things that aren't true.

Concrete bad lines on the live `index.html`:

| Live site | What's wrong |
|---|---|
| Title: *"engineer building agentic AI on real systems"* | Positioning was dropped |
| H1: *"…I'm putting agentic AI into them"* | Same |
| Lede claims: *"an agentic research layer: every position carries an LLM-maintained thesis tied to SEC filings, with automated drift detection — shipped with an eval set"* | **This system was never built** — the position-thesis-agent spec was deleted |
| Primary CTA: *"See the AI work"* | Same |
| Architecture diagram: *SEC EDGAR → Research agent → Thesis store* | Diagrams something that doesn't exist |
| Quote: *"Every position has an LLM-maintained thesis tied to SEC filings… Here's the eval set."* | False |
| FamilyFund card: *"Laravel 11"*, *"1,791 tests"* | Actually Laravel 12, ~240 files / 2,200+ tests |
| About: *"early-stage AI startup — building agent systems on real data"* | Positioning is broader seed–Series B now |

Plus drift vs. our new resume positioning:
- About line: *"comfortable leading a small team (2–4)"* — resume dropped specific team-size counts.
- Hero: *"solo, end to end"* — resume softened to "end to end".
- No mention of AI-as-capability (LLMs / agentic CLIs) — the new positioning addition.
- Resume PDF link: still missing.

**Recommended punch list, in priority order:**

1. **Personal hub copy refresh** — `websites/personal/README.md` (the spec) → bring in resume's current Summary, AI-as-capability, no team-size specifics.
2. **DS Trader page** — likely has identical AI narrative drift (haven't read it yet); needs to be rules-based-only.
3. **FamilyFund page** — fix Laravel 11→12, test counts, add the 2026-expansion features (multi-account funds, multi-tenant ACL, projections).
4. **Rewrite the live HTML** (`~/dev/jdtogni-site/{index,dstrader,familyfund}.html`) from updated specs — same plain HTML, same architecture diagram template but with the AI bottom row removed.
5. **Resume PDF** — export `resume-full.md` to PDF, drop into the site repo, link from hub + footer.
6. **Push & redeploy** — single commit to `jdtogni78/jdtogni-site`; Cloudflare Pages will auto-deploy.
